physics_goals.quote: The total cross section will be measured using the luminosity independent method which based on the simultaneous detection of elastic scattering at low momentum transfer and of the inelastic interactions. This method also provides an absolute calibration of the machine luminosity.
physics_goals.value: Measure the total, elastic and diffractive proton-proton cross sections at the LHC, and provide a luminosity-independent absolute calibration of the machine luminosity

summary.plain: TOTEM sits around CMS's collision point and measures protons that barely miss each other, letting physicists work out the total chance that two protons collide at all -- one of the most basic numbers in particle physics.
summary.technical: Forward-physics experiment sharing LHC interaction point 5 with CMS: 26 Roman Pot detectors plus T1/T2 forward tracking telescopes, ~3000 kg of equipment spread over ~0.5 km, measuring total, elastic and diffractive pp cross sections via the luminosity-independent method. Proposed August 1997, approved November 1999, first data November 2009; ran combined measurements with CMS from 2015.

unique_capabilities.quote: the Roman pot is moved toward the machine axis by compressing the bellows until the inner edge of the detectors reaches a distance of the order of one millimeter from the beam
unique_capabilities.value: Roman Pot detectors that move silicon sensors to within about 1 mm of the circulating beam once it is stable, detecting protons scattered at very small angles that no other LHC detector can reach
